WITH relogios AS (
  SELECT r.review_score,
         r.review_creation_date,
         CASE WHEN r.review_creation_date >= DATE '2018-01-01' AND r.review_creation_date < DATE '2018-02-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS in_window,
         CASE WHEN r.review_creation_date >= DATE '2017-12-01' AND r.review_creation_date < DATE '2018-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS in_baseline
  FROM reviews.order_reviews r
  JOIN orders.orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN orders.order_items i ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  JOIN orders.products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE p.product_category_name = 'relogios_presentes'
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN in_window = 1 THEN review_score END),4) AS value,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN in_baseline = 1 THEN review_score END),4) AS baseline,
  SUM(in_window) AS window_total_reviews,
  SUM(in_baseline) AS baseline_total_reviews,
  SUM(CASE WHEN in_window = 0 AND review_creation_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS window_out_of_range,
  SUM(CASE WHEN in_baseline = 0 AND review_creation_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS baseline_out_of_range,
  SUM(CASE WHEN review_creation_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_null_dates
FROM relogios;
